sentences: Do you want to live to a hundred?
Or more?
This woman lived to one hundred twenty-two.
She was born in France in eighteen seventy-five.
She smoked until she was one hundred seventeen.
She ate about two pounds of chocolate a week.
At eighty-five, she took up fencing.
At one hundred, she was still riding her bike.
But her best move was a deal.
At ninety, she sold her apartment to a lawyer.
He was forty-seven.
He'd pay her every month until she died.
Then the place was his.
He paid for thirty years.
Then he died first.
His family kept paying.
She collected more than double what it was worth.
At one hundred twenty, someone asked about her future.
Her answer?
A very short one.
